description: This file contains a PHP trait named ControllerTrait within the OrangeHRM project, providing common controller functionalities such as forwarding requests, obtaining the current request, and performing redirects. It is used to share reusable controller-related methods across classes.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forwards the current request to another controller, creating a sub-request with specified attributes and query parameters, and returns the response.

methods.name: getCurrentRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTTP request from the request stack.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Generates a redirect response to the specified path, attaching the base URL from the current request.
